body:
Raised/recorded: 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles). Bounded follow-up from [#422](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/422) and its evidence PR [#994](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/994). Findings are provisional until the packet merges.

## Goal

For the exact three Kosovo Atlas subjects and parents, restore the original source/archive lineage for the seven-feature geoBoundaries ADM1 collection, resolve the metadata count 48 versus seven district polygons and the official seven regional zones/38 municipalities, and establish lawful reuse terms for the 2021 OSM-derived source. Compare all seven against authoritative sources if lawful, explain why three fall in this area scope, and give bounded parent-area/source recommendations. Do not infer political status or make a license compatibility claim without evidence.

## Exact scope

Atlas location IDs (pinned):
```json
{
  "subject_ids": [
    "gb:XKX:ADM1:2360587B5118871504069",
    "gb:XKX:ADM1:2360587B74553771763221",
    "gb:XKX:ADM1:2360587B95703323116719"
  ],
  "subject_count": 3,
  "parent_issue": 422
}
```

Atlas province parent IDs (reference only):
```json
[
  "framework:province:district-of-ferizaj:53e696afd661",
  "framework:province:district-of-gjilan:d48796969836",
  "framework:province:district-of-prishtina:f033b08833f6"
]
```

See the scoped per-subject evidence, exact upstream inputs, source hashes and citations in `data/regional-review/regional-review-3c4fe25a21fa428d/` after PR #994 merges. Current findings and unresolved limits are summarized in its `REVIEW.md`.

## Acceptance

- Research every exact subject and its relevant parent relationship using authoritative dated sources.
- Retain lawful original source bytes or explicit retrieval/restoration instructions; record URLs, retrieval dates, vintages, hashes, completeness and license limits.
- Reproduce exact ID crosswalks and methods; report unsupported/uncertain cases honestly.
- Provide evidence-backed, ID-preserving correction/source-restoration recommendations and explicit engineering handoffs.
- Do not edit shared geography, publish, import, or certify the area/region.

Do not claim legal boundary accuracy from counts, aggregate area, topology or source labels alone. Preserve old evidence and Atlas IDs. This is source-only geography research and authorizes no boundary mutation, regional approval or historical import.
